title: Brachial Plexus Anatomy & Clinical Lesions
description: Roots (C5-T1), trunks, divisions, cords, terminal branches. Compare Erb-Duchenne palsy (waiter's tip) vs Klumpke palsy (claw hand).

title: Circle of Willis & Cerebral Vascular Territories
description: Anterior/posterior circulation, ACA vs MCA vs PCA stroke syndromes, common berry aneurysm sites at junctions.

title: Inguinal Canal & Hernia Anatomy
description: Walls, rings (deep/superficial), contents in males and females. Distinguish direct vs indirect inguinal hernia relative to inferior epigastric vessels.

title: Coronary Arteries & Cardiac Dominance
description: LAD, LCx, RCA branching. Right vs left dominant circulation based on PDA origin; blood supply to SA/AV nodes.

title: Cranial Nerves: Functions, Exits, and Palsies
description: All 12 CNs, skull base foramina, sensory/motor/parasympathetic modalities, Bell's palsy vs central facial droop.

title: Diaphragm Apertures & Congenital Hernias
description: T8 (IVC), T10 (Esophagus/Vagus), T12 (Aorta/Thoracic duct/Azygos). Bochdalek vs Morgagni congenital diaphragmatic hernias.

title: Popliteal Fossa Anatomy & Neurovascular Relationships
description: Boundaries (biceps femoris, semimembranosus, gastrocnemius), deep-to-superficial order: popliteal artery, vein, tibial nerve. Baker cyst.

title: Biliary Tree & Triangle of Calot
description: Cystic duct, common hepatic duct, cystic artery (Calot's triangle boundaries). Cholecystectomy anatomical landmarks and bile duct injury risks.

title: Rotator Cuff Muscles and Shoulder Stability
description: SITS muscles (Supraspinatus, Infraspinatus, Teres minor, Subscapularis), innervation, actions, and drop-arm test for supraspinatus tear.

title: Portosystemic Anastomoses & Portal Hypertension
description: Esophageal varices, caput medusae, anorectal varices, retroperitoneal veins. Portal vein tributaties vs systemic drainage.

title: Femoral Triangle & Femoral Sheath
description: Boundaries (inguinal ligament, sartorius, adductor longus), contents from lateral to medial: NAVEL. Femoral canal and femoral hernia risk.

title: Larynx Cartilages & Vocal Cord Innervation
description: Thyroid, cricoid, arytenoid cartilages. Superior vs Recurrent laryngeal nerve functions, unilateral vs bilateral RLN injury consequences.

title: Cavernous Sinus Anatomy & Thrombosis
description: Structures traversing the sinus (CN III, IV, V1, V2, VI, internal carotid artery). Clinical presentation of cavernous sinus thrombosis.

title: Mediastinal Compartments & Associated Masses
description: Superior, anterior (4 Ts: Thymoma, Teratoma, Thyroid, Terrible lymphoma), middle (pericardial, bronchogenic), posterior (neurogenic).

title: Renal Vasculature & The Nutcracker Phenomenon
description: Left vs right renal vein anatomy, left gonadal vein insertion, SMA compression of left renal vein leading to hematuria and varicocele.

title: Anterior Abdominal Wall Layers & Surgical Incisions
description: Skin to peritoneum: Camper/Scarpa fascias, rectus sheath transition above vs below arcuate line, linea alba, McBurney's and Pfannenstiel incisions.

title: Pelvic Floor Musculature & Perineal Body
description: Levator ani (puborectalis, pubococcygeus, iliococcygeus), coccygeus, perineal membrane. Role in continence and pelvic organ prolapse.

title: Spinal Cord Cross-Sectional Tracts & Cord Syndromes
description: Dorsal columns, spinothalamic tracts, corticospinal tracts. Brown-Séquard syndrome, anterior cord syndrome, central cord (syringomyelia).

title: Thoracic Duct Anatomy & Chylothorax
description: Origin at cisterna chyli, ascent through aortic hiatus (T12), drainage into left venous angle (subclavian-internal jugular junction).

title: Lumbosacral Plexus & Sciatic Nerve Pathway
description: L4-S3 roots, greater sciatic foramen, relationship with piriformis muscle, bifurcation into tibial and common fibular (peroneal) nerves.

title: Eye Anatomy & Aqueous Humor Dynamics
description: Ciliary body production, flow through anterior chamber, drainage via trabecular meshwork and Schlemm's canal; open vs closed-angle glaucoma.

title: Ulnar Nerve Course, Entrapment & Deformities
description: Medial epicondyle (cubital tunnel) vs Guyon canal. Guyon canal vs cubital tunnel palsy presentation; ulnar paradox.

title: Median Nerve Anatomy & Carpal Tunnel Syndrome
description: Roots C5-T1, pronator teres, carpal tunnel contents (flexor tendons + median nerve), ape hand vs hand of benediction, Phalen/Tinel tests.

title: Peritoneal Ligaments & Lesser Sac Entry
description: Hepatoduodenal ligament (Pringle maneuver: portal triad compression), gastrocolic, splenorenal ligaments. Foramen of Winslow.

title: Middle Meningeal Artery & Epidural Hematoma
description: Branch of maxillary artery, enters skull via foramen spinosum, passes deep to pterion. Classic lucid interval and biconvex lens on CT.

title: Deep Peroneal vs Superficial Peroneal Nerve
description: Anterior vs lateral compartment of leg. Foot drop, webspace sensory loss (deep) vs dorsal foot sensory loss (superficial).

title: Internal Capsule Somatotopy & Lacunar Infarctions
description: Anterior limb, genu, posterior limb. Pure motor stroke (posterior limb) vs pure sensory stroke (thalamus / posterior limb).

title: Great Saphenous Vein Course & Harvest Landmarks
description: Medial malleolus origin, medial knee, saphenofemoral junction; saphenous nerve companion and sensory deficit risks.

title: Thyroid Gland Vasculature & Surrounding Nerves
description: Superior thyroid artery (ECA) / external branch of SLN, inferior thyroid artery (thyrocervical trunk) / recurrent laryngeal nerve.

title: Coronary Sinus Anatomy & Cardiac Veins
description: Great, middle, and small cardiac veins drainage into coronary sinus, opening into right atrium via Thebesian valve.

title: Frank-Starling Law of the Heart & PV Loops
description: End-diastolic volume vs stroke volume relationship. Preload, afterload, inotropy shifts on left ventricular pressure-volume loops.

title: Renin-Angiotensin-Aldosterone System (RAAS)
description: Juxtaglomerular apparatus triggers, ACE function, Angiotensin II systemic actions, Aldosterone effect on principal cells, ADH release.

title: Cardiac Action Potentials: Pacemaker vs Ventricular
description: Phase 0-4 ion channels (If funny current, Ca2+ L-type, K+ rectifiers, fast Na+ channels). Autonomic modulation and refractory periods.

title: Oxygen-Hemoglobin Dissociation Curve Shifts
description: Right shift (CADET face right: CO2, Acidosis, 2,3-BPG, Exercise, Temp) vs Left shift (fetal Hb, methemoglobin, carbon monoxide, alkalosis).

title: Nephron Solute Transport & Countercurrent Multiplier
description: PCT (NHE3, SGLT2), TAL (NKCC2, voltage gradient), DCT (NCCT, Ca2+ reabsorption), Collecting duct (ENaC, ROMK, Aquaporin-2).

title: Pulmonary Ventilation-Perfusion (V/Q) Dynamics
description: Apex vs base regional differences (West zones). Hypoxic pulmonary vasoconstriction, shunt (V/Q=0) vs dead space (V/Q=infinity).

title: Hypothalamic-Pituitary-Thyroid & Adrenal Axes
description: TRH-TSH-T3/T4 and CRH-ACTH-Cortisol negative feedback mechanisms, diurnal cortisol rhythm, primary vs secondary endocrine failure.

title: Acid-Base Regulation: Winter's Formula & Anion Gap
description: Metabolic acidosis compensation (Winter's formula), High vs Normal Anion Gap acidosis (MUDPILES / HARDUPS), delta-delta ratio.

title: Neuromuscular Junction Transmission & Excitation-Contraction
description: Presynaptic Ca2+ entry, ACh release, nicotinic receptor activation, T-tubule DHP-RyR coupling, SR Ca2+ release, cross-bridge cycle.

title: Glomerular Filtration Rate & Autoregulation
description: Starling forces across glomerular capillaries, myogenic mechanism, tubuloglomerular feedback (macula densa adenosine/NO), afferent vs efferent tone.

title: Hemostasis: Primary vs Secondary Coagulation Cascade
description: Platelet adhesion (vWF/GPIb), activation (TXA2/ADP), aggregation (GPIIb/IIIa). Extrinsic (TF/VIIa), intrinsic (XII, XI, IX, VIII), common pathway (X, V, II, I).

title: Gastrointestinal Hormones: Gastrin, CCK, Secretin, GIP
description: Cell origins (G, I, S, K cells), stimulatory triggers, downstream target organ effects on gastric acid, bile release, and bicarbonate secretion.

title: Baroreceptor Reflex & Orthostatic Blood Pressure Control
description: Carotid sinus (CN IX) vs Aortic arch (CN X) baroreceptors. Nucleus tractus solitarius processing, sympathetic vs vagal efferents in postural change.

title: Cerebrospinal Fluid Dynamics & Blood-Brain Barrier
description: Choroid plexus production, ventricular circulation (Monro, Sylvius, Luschka/Magendie), arachnoid villi reabsorption. Endothelial tight junctions & astrocytes.

title: Control of Breathing: Central vs Peripheral Chemoreceptors
description: Medullary central chemoreceptors (CSF pH / PaCO2) vs Carotid/aortic bodies (PaO2 < 60 mmHg, pH, PaCO2). Hering-Breuer reflex.

title: Basal Ganglia Direct & Indirect Pathways
description: Striatum D1 (direct/pro-kinetic) vs D2 (indirect/anti-kinetic) pathways, substantia nigra compacta dopamine tuning, STN and GPi output to thalamus.

title: Pancreatic Islet Hormones: Insulin & Glucagon Signaling
description: Beta cell GLUT2 and ATP-sensitive K+ channels triggering insulin exocytosis. Tyrosine kinase receptor vs GPCR/cAMP glucagon pathway.

title: Calcium Homeostasis: PTH, Calcitriol, and Calcitonin
description: Chief cell calcium-sensing receptor (CaSR), PTH actions on bone resorption (RANKL), renal distal Ca2+ reabsorption, and 1-alpha-hydroxylase activation.

title: Cardiac Cycle: Wiggers Diagram & Heart Sounds
description: Isovolumetric contraction/relaxation, rapid ejection/filling. Physiological basis of S1, S2, physiological splitting, S3 (volume overload), S4 (stiff LV).

title: Gastric Acid Secretion & Parietal Cell Mechanism
description: H+/K+ ATPase pump, histamine (H2/Gs), ACh (M3/Gq), gastrin (CCKB/Gq), and somatostatin/prostaglandin (Gi) regulation.

title: Capillary Fluid Exchange: Starling Forces & Edema
description: Hydrostatic pressure vs Oncotic pressure gradients, reflection coefficient, mechanisms of edema in heart failure, cirrhosis, nephrotic syndrome, and inflammation.

title: Sodium and Water Balance: ADH and Osmoreceptors
description: Supraoptic/paraventricular hypothalamic nuclei, plasma osmolality threshold (280-295 mOsm/kg), V2 receptor cAMP cascade and aquaporin-2 insertion.

title: Thermoregulation & Fever Pathophysiology
description: Preoptic anterior hypothalamus, endogenous pyrogens (IL-1, IL-6, TNF-alpha), PGE2 hypothalamic set-point elevation vs heat stroke hyperthermia.

title: Exercise Physiology: Cardiopulmonary Adaptation
description: VO2 max, anaerobic threshold, cardiac output redistribution, skeletal muscle hyperemia via local metabolites (adenosine, K+, lactate, CO2).

title: Iron Absorption, Transport, and Hepcidin Regulation
description: DMT-1 in duodenum, ferroportin exporter, transferrin binding, ferritin storage. Hepcidin degradation of ferroportin in chronic inflammation.

title: Bilirubin Metabolism: Conjugation & Enterohepatic Circulation
description: Heme breakdown to unconjugated bilirubin, albumin binding, UDP-glucuronosyltransferase (UGT1A1) conjugation, urobilinogen synthesis.

title: Auditory Transduction & Tonotopic Organization
description: Organ of Corti hair cell stereocilia deflection, K+ influx via endolymph, basilar membrane frequency mapping (base=high pitch, apex=low pitch).

title: Spermatogenesis & Hypothalamic-Pituitary-Gonadal Axis
description: GnRH pulsatility, LH on Leydig cells (testosterone), FSH on Sertoli cells (inhibin B, androgen-binding protein, blood-testis barrier).

title: Menstrual Cycle: Follicular, Ovulatory, and Luteal Phases
description: Estrogen positive feedback trigger for LH surge, corpus luteum progesterone production, endometrial proliferation and secretory transformation.

title: Renal Clearance & Inulin vs Creatinine vs PAH
description: Clearance formula (Ux*V/Px). Inulin for true GFR, creatinine slight tubular secretion, PAH for Renal Plasma Flow (RPF), filtration fraction (GFR/RPF).

title: Atherosclerosis Pathogenesis & Plaque Rupture
description: Endothelial injury, LDL oxidation, macrophage scavenger uptake (foam cells), fatty streak, smooth muscle migration, fibrous cap thinning and thrombosis.

title: Cell Death: Necrosis Patterns vs Apoptosis Pathways
description: Coagulative, liquefactive, caseous, fat, fibrinoid, and gangrenous necrosis. Intrinsic (mitochondrial/Bcl-2/Bax) vs Extrinsic (FasL/TNF) apoptosis pathways.

title: Hypersensitivity Reactions: Types I through IV
description: Type I (IgE/mast cell), Type II (cytotoxic antibody/complement), Type III (immune-complex deposition), Type IV (T-cell mediated delayed hypersensitivity).

title: Nephritic vs Nephrotic Syndrome Glomerulopathies
description: Nephrotic (MCD, FSGS, Membranous) with massive proteinuria vs Nephritic (PSGN, IgA nephropathy, RPGN) with hematuria, RBC casts, hypertension.

title: Acute Myocardial Infarction: Histopathological Timeline
description: 0-4h (wavy fibers), 4-24h (coagulation necrosis, contraction bands), 1-3d (neutrophils), 3-7d (macrophages), 7-10d (granulation/rupture risk), >2w (scar).

title: Systemic Lupus Erythematosus (SLE) Immunopathology
description: Loss of self-tolerance, anti-dsDNA, anti-Smith, complement consumption (low C3/C4), lupus nephritis classes, libman-sacks endocarditis.

title: Shock Pathophysiology: Hypovolemic, Cardiogenic, Distributive, Obstructive
description: Hemodynamic profiling: CVP/PCWP, Cardiac Output, Systemic Vascular Resistance (SVR), mixed venous SvO2 across all 4 shock classes.

title: Hemolytic Anemias: Intrinsic vs Extrinsic & Intravascular vs Extravascular
description: Spherocytosis, G6PD deficiency, Sickle cell vs AIHA, TTP/HUS. Biomarkers: high LDH, high unconjugated bilirubin, low haptoglobin, schistocytes.

title: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD): Emphysema vs Bronchitis
description: Centriacinar (smoking) vs Panacinar (alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency). Reid index in chronic bronchitis, dynamic airway collapse, loss of elastic recoil.

title: Cirrhosis Pathogenesis & Hepatic Stellate Cell Role
description: Ito/Stellate cells transformation to myofibroblasts, TGF-beta mediated collagen I/III deposition, sinusoidal architectural distortion, portal hypertension.

title: Oncogenesis: Proto-oncogenes vs Tumor Suppressors (Two-Hit Hypothesis)
description: Knudson two-hit hypothesis (RB1, TP53, APC, BRCA1/2) vs gain-of-function proto-oncogenes (KRAS, MYC, HER2/neu, BCR-ABL).

title: Deep Vein Thrombosis & Virchow's Triad
description: Endothelial injury, stasis, hypercoagulability (Factor V Leiden, Prothrombin G20210A, Antiphospholipid syndrome). Risk for pulmonary embolism.

title: Disseminated Intravascular Coagulation (DIC)
description: Systemic thrombin generation, widespread microvascular thrombosis, consumption coagulopathy (prolonged PT/PTT, low platelets, low fibrinogen, elevated D-dimer).

title: Amyloidosis: AL vs AA vs Transthyretin (ATTR)
description: Beta-pleated sheet fibril deposition, Congo red apple-green birefringence under polarized light. Light-chain vs SAA chronic inflammation vs cardiac ATTR.

title: Thrombotic Thrombocytopenic Purpura (TTP) vs HUS
description: ADAMTS13 deficiency / ultra-large vWF multimers (TTP pentad: FAT RN) vs Shiga-toxin mediated endothelial damage in child bloody diarrhea (HUS triad).

title: Inflammatory Bowel Disease: Crohn's Disease vs Ulcerative Colitis
description: Transmural skip lesions, cobblestoning, non-caseating granulomas (Crohn's) vs Mucosal continuous pseudopolyps, crypt abscesses, toxic megacolon (UC).

title: Acute Pancreatitis Pathophysiology & Complications
description: Intra-acinar premature trypsinogen activation, autodigestion, enzymatic fat necrosis, hypocalcemia (saponification), pseudocyst, ARDS.

title: Multiple Myeloma & Monoclonal Gammopathies
description: CRAB criteria (Hypercalcemia, Renal insufficiency, Anemia, Bone lytic lesions), Rouleaux formation, serum protein electrophoresis M-spike, Bence-Jones proteinuria.

title: Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome (ARDS) Pathogenesis
description: Diffuse alveolar damage, neutrophil activation, capillary leak, alveolar exudate with hyaline membranes, loss of surfactant, PaO2/FiO2 < 300.

title: Parkinson's Disease Neuropathology: Alpha-Synuclein & Lewy Bodies
description: Degeneration of dopaminergic neurons in substantia nigra pars compacta, eosinophilic Lewy bodies (alpha-synuclein), resting tremor, rigidity, bradykinesia.

title: Alzheimer's Disease Neuropathology: Plaques & Neurofibrillary Tangles
description: Extracellular Amyloid-beta 42 plaques (cleaved from APP via beta/gamma secretase) and intracellular hyperphosphorylated tau neurofibrillary tangles, ApoE4 risk.

title: Acute Kidney Injury: Prerenal vs Intrinsic (ATN) vs Postrenal
description: BUN/Cr ratio > 20:1 and FENa < 1% in prerenal vs muddy brown granular casts and FENa > 2% in Acute Tubular Necrosis (ATN).

title: Gout vs Pseudogout Crystal Arthropathies
description: Monosodium urate (needle-shaped, negatively birefringent, yellow when parallel) vs Calcium pyrophosphate (rhomboid, positively birefringent, blue when parallel).

title: Thyroiditis Types: Hashimoto's, Subacute De Quervain's, Riedel's
description: Anti-TPO/anti-Tg with Hürthle cells and germinal centers (Hashimoto) vs painful post-viral granulomatous (De Quervain) vs rock-hard IgG4 fibrosis (Riedel).

title: Vasculitides Classification: Large, Medium, Small Vessel
description: Temporal/Takayasu (large); Polyarteritis nodosa/Kawasaki (medium); GPA (c-ANCA/PR3), MPA/EGPA (p-ANCA/MPO), Henoch-Schönlein purpura (IgA small vessel).

title: Leukemias: ALL vs AML vs CLL vs CML
description: Auer rods/myeloperoxidase in AML (t(15;17) APL), terminal deoxynucleotidyl transferase (TdT) in ALL, smudge cells in CLL, BCR-ABL t(9;22) in CML.

title: Aortic Aneurysm vs Aortic Dissection
description: Cystic medial necrosis and atherosclerosis (AAA) vs Intimal tear and false lumen propagation (Stanford Type A involving ascending aorta vs Type B descending).

title: Pulmonary Hypertension: WHO Groups 1 through 5
description: Group 1 (PAH: BMPR2, plexiform lesions), Group 2 (Left heart disease), Group 3 (Lung disease/hypoxia), Group 4 (CTEPH), Group 5 (multifactorial).

title: Autoimmune Hepatitis vs Primary Biliary Cholangitis vs PSC
description: Anti-SMA / ANA in AIH; Anti-mitochondrial antibodies (AMA) in PBC (interlobular duct destruction); p-ANCA, onion-skin bile duct fibrosis with IBD link (PSC).

title: Rheumatoid Arthritis vs Osteoarthritis Joint Pathology
description: Pannus formation, synovial hyperplasia, anti-CCP, symmetric MCP/PIP sparing DIP (RA) vs chondrocyte breakdown, osteophytes, subchondral sclerosis (OA).

title: Beta-Blockers: Cardioselective vs Non-Selective vs Mixed Alpha/Beta
description: Metoprolol/Atenolol (beta-1 selective), Propranolol/Timolol (non-selective, bronchospasm risk), Carvedilol/Labetalol (alpha-1 and beta blocker for heart failure/emergencies).

title: Direct Oral Anticoagulants (DOACs) vs Warfarin & Reversal Agents
description: Factor Xa inhibitors (Apixaban, Rivaroxaban / Andexanet alfa), Thrombin inhibitor (Dabigatran / Idarucizumab) vs Warfarin (VKORC1 / Vitamin K, PCC).

title: Anti-Hypertensives: ACE-Is, ARBs, and Neprilysin Inhibitors (ARNI)
description: Lisinopril (bradykinin cough, angioedema risk), Losartan (AT1 blocker without cough), Sacubitril/Valsartan mechanism in HFrEF.

title: Diuretics Classes & Electrolyte Derangements
description: Loop (Furosemide / hypokalemia, ototoxicity, calcium wasting), Thiazides (HCTZ / hypercalcemia, hyperuricemia), K+-sparing (Spironolactone / hyperkalemia, gynecomastia).

title: Antibiotics: Cell Wall Synthesis Inhibitors & Resistance Mechanisms
description: Penicillins, Cephalosporins, Carbapenems (PBP binding), Vancomycin (D-Ala-D-Ala binding). Beta-lactamases, ESBL, PBP2a mutation in MRSA, VanA operon in VRE.

title: Statins & Lipid-Lowering Therapies
description: HMG-CoA reductase inhibitors (Atorvastatin), Ezetimibe (NPC1L1 cholesterol absorption inhibitor), PCSK9 monoclonal antibodies (Evolocumab), Fibrates (PPAR-alpha).

title: Oral Hypoglycemics: SGLT2i, GLP-1 RA, Metformin, Sulfonylureas
description: Metformin (AMPK activation, lactic acidosis), Empagliflozin (SGLT2 inhibition, euglycemic DKA, cardioprotection), Semaglutide (GLP-1 receptor agonist).

title: Opioid Analgesics: Receptor Mechanisms, Toxicity, and Naloxone
description: Mu-opioid receptor Gi coupling (decreased presynaptic Ca2+, increased postsynaptic K+). Overdose triad: CNS depression, respiratory depression, pinpoint pupils (miosis).

title: Antiarrhythmics: Vaughan-Williams Classification System
description: Class I (Na+ blockers: Ia Procainamide, Ib Lidocaine, Ic Flecainide), Class II (Beta-blockers), Class III (K+ blockers: Amiodarone, Sotalol), Class IV (CCBs: Verapamil, Diltiazem).

title: Cytochrome P450 Enzymes: Major Inducers & Inhibitors
description: CYP3A4/2D6/2C9. Inducers (Rifampin, Carbamazepine, St. John's wort, Phenytoin) vs Inhibitors (Grapefruit juice, Ketoconazole, Macrolides, Cimetidine, Ciprofloxacin).

title: Immunosuppressive Drugs in Solid Organ Transplantation
description: Calcineurin inhibitors (Tacrolimus, Cyclosporine), Antimetabolites (Mycophenolate Mofetil / IMPDH inhibitor), mTOR inhibitors (Sirolimus), Glucocorticoids.

title: Biologics & DMARDs in Rheumatoid Arthritis
description: Methotrexate (dihydrofolate reductase / adenosine release), TNF-alpha blockers (Infliximab, Adalimumab, Etanercept: TB reactivation risk), Rituximab (anti-CD20).

title: Proton Pump Inhibitors & H2 Receptor Antagonists
description: Omeprazole (irreversible H+/K+ ATPase inhibition, hypomagnesemia, C. diff risk, B12 deficiency) vs Famotidine (competitive H2 receptor antagonism).

title: Antidepressants: SSRIs, SNRIs, TCAs, and MAO Inhibitors
description: Serotonin syndrome risk (SSRIs + MAOIs), TCA cardiotoxicity (Na+ channel blockade, wide QRS, sodium bicarbonate antidote), Tyramine cheese reaction with MAOIs.

title: Local Anesthetics: Esters vs Amides & Epinephrine Co-administration
description: Lidocaine, Bupivacaine (amides with two 'i's) vs Procaine, Tetracaine (esters). Voltage-gated Na+ channel blockade, lipid emulsion rescue for LAST.

title: Antipsychotics: Typical vs Atypical & Extrapyramidal Side Effects
description: Haloperidol (D2 antagonism, acute dystonia, akathisia, tardive dyskinesia, NMS) vs Clozapine (5-HT2A/D2, agranulocytosis monitoring, metabolic syndrome).

title: General Anesthetics: Inhaled vs Intravenous Agents
description: Sevoflurane/Isoflurane (MAC, blood-gas partition coefficient, malignant hyperthermia with Dantrolene antidote) vs Propofol, Etomidate, Ketamine.

title: Nonsteroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs (NSAIDs) & COX Selectivity
description: Ibuprofen/Naproxen (non-selective COX-1/2, gastric ulceration, renal afferent vasoconstriction) vs Celecoxib (selective COX-2, thrombotic cardiovascular risk).

title: Aminoglycosides & Glycopeptides: Mechanisms & Toxicities
description: Gentamicin (30S ribosomal subunit inhibition, nephrotoxicity, ototoxicity) vs Vancomycin (red man syndrome due to histamine release, nephrotoxicity).

title: Antifungal Agents: Azoles, Echinocandins, Polyenes
description: Fluconazole (ergosterol synthesis 14-alpha-demethylase inhibition), Caspofungin (beta-1,3-glucan cell wall inhibition), Amphotericin B (ergosterol pore formation).

title: Antiviral Therapy for HIV: HAART Drug Classes
description: NRTIs (Tenofovir, Emtricitabine), NNRTIs (Efavirenz), Protease inhibitors (Darunavir + Ritonavir boost), Integrase strand transfer inhibitors (Dolutegravir).

title: Parkinson's Disease Pharmacotherapy: Levodopa, COMT, MAO-B
description: Levodopa/Carbidopa (DOPA decarboxylase inhibition outside BBB), Entacapone (COMT inhibitor), Selegiline (MAO-B inhibitor), Pramipexole (dopamine agonist).

title: Neuromuscular Blockers: Depolarizing vs Non-Depolarizing
description: Succinylcholine (Phase I & II block, hyperkalemia risk, malignant hyperthermia) vs Rocuronium (competitive nAChR antagonist / Sugammadex reversal).

title: Chemotherapy Alkylating Agents & Platinum Compounds
description: Cyclophosphamide (DNA crosslinking, hemorrhagic cystitis prevented by Mesna) vs Cisplatin (nephrotoxicity, ototoxicity, peripheral neuropathy).

title: Cardiac Inotropes & Vasopressors: Receptor Profiles
description: Norepinephrine (alpha-1 > beta-1), Epinephrine (beta > alpha at low dose), Dobutamine (beta-1 inotrope), Milrinone (PDE-3 inhibitor inodilator), Vasopressin (V1).

title: Antiemetic Agents: 5-HT3, NK1, and Dopamine Antagonists
description: Ondansetron (5-HT3 antagonist, QT prolongation), Aprepitant (substance P / NK1 antagonist for chemo-induced nausea), Metoclopramide (D2 prokinetic).

title: Thyroid Pharmacology: Methimazole, PTU, and Radioiodine
description: Propylthiouracil (thyroid peroxidase + peripheral T4-to-T3 conversion block, safe in 1st trimester) vs Methimazole (teratogenic aplasia cutis risk in 1st trimester).

title: Antiepileptic Drugs: Mechanisms of Action & Side Effects
description: Sodium channel blockers (Phenytoin / gingival hyperplasia, Carbamazepine / SIADH, Lamotrigine / SJS), Levetiracetam (SV2A), Valproate (GABA / hepatotoxicity/teratogen).

title: Nitrates & Phosphodiesterase-5 Inhibitors: Fatal Interaction
description: Nitroglycerin (NO donor, guanylyl cyclase, cGMP smooth muscle relaxation) combined with Sildenafil (PDE-5 inhibition) causing profound refractory hypotension.

title: Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors in Oncology: PD-1 & CTLA-4
description: Pembrolizumab/Nivolumab (anti-PD-1) and Ipilimumab (anti-CTLA-4). Restores antitumor T-cell cytotoxicity; immune-related adverse events (colitis, hypophysitis).

title: Staphylococcus aureus: Toxins, Virulence, and MRSA
description: Protein A (Fc binding), TSST-1 superantigen, Exfoliatin (SSSS), Enterotoxin (food poisoning). Coagulase positive vs CoNS; mecA gene mediating MRSA.

title: Streptococcus Species Classification: Hemolysis & Grouping
description: Beta-hemolytic (GAS S. pyogenes / bacitracin sensitive; GBS S. agalactiae / CAMP positive), Alpha-hemolytic (S. pneumoniae / optochin sensitive vs S. viridans).

title: Gram-Negative Bacilli: Enterobacteriaceae & Lactose Fermentation
description: MacConkey agar pink fermenters (E. coli, Klebsiella, Enterobacter) vs Non-fermenters (Salmonella, Shigella, Proteus, Pseudomonas). Triple Sugar Iron (TSI) agar.

title: Pseudomonas aeruginosa: Pathogenesis & Clinical Spectrum
description: Exotoxin A (EF-2 inactivation), pyocyanin blue-green pigment, mucoid alginate biofilm in Cystic Fibrosis, ecthyma gangrenosum, hot tub folliculitis, malignant otitis.

title: Clostridioides difficile Colitis: Toxins & Treatment
description: Gram-positive spore-forming anaerobe post-antibiotics. Toxin A (enterotoxin/fluid secretion) and Toxin B (cytotoxin/actin disruption). Oral Vancomycin or Fidaxomicin.

title: Mycobacterium tuberculosis: Ghon Complex & Latency
description: Acid-fast Ziehl-Neelsen stain, cord factor, sulfatides (phagosome-lysosome fusion block). Primary Ghon focus/complex vs Reactivation cavitary disease (TNF-dependent granulomas).

title: Viral Hepatitis Serology & Natural History: HBV vs HCV
description: HBsAg, HBsAb, HBcAb IgM vs IgG, HBeAg. Window period serology. HCV chronic persistence and direct-acting antiviral (DAA) targets.

title: Atypical Pneumonia Pathogens: Mycoplasma, Legionella, Chlamydia
description: Mycoplasma pneumoniae (cold agglutinins / IgM), Legionella pneumophila (hyponatremia, diarrhea, silver/charcoal BCYE stain), Chlamydia psittaci (bird exposure).

title: Herpesviridae Family: HSV-1, HSV-2, VZV, EBV, CMV, HHV-8
description: Enveloped dsDNA viruses with latency. Sensory ganglia latency (HSV/VZV), B cell latency (EBV / mononucleosis), congenital TORCH (CMV), Kaposi sarcoma (HHV-8).

title: Neisseria meningitidis vs Neisseria gonorrhoeae
description: Gram-negative diplococci. Maltose fermentation (Meningococcus ferments Maltose + Glucose; Gonococcus Glucose only). LOS endotoxin, pili antigenic variation.

title: Spirochetes: Treponema pallidum (Syphilis) Stages & Serology
description: Primary painless chancre, secondary condyloma lata/rash on palms and soles, tertiary gummas/tabes dorsalis/Argyll Robertson pupils. Non-treponemal (VDRL/RPR) vs FTA-ABS.

title: Systemic Mycoses: Histoplasma, Blastomyces, Coccidioides
description: Dimorphic fungi (mold in the cold, yeast in the heat). Histoplasma (bird/bat guano, intracellular macrophages), Blasto (broad-based budding), Cocci (spherules with endospores).

title: Opportunistic Fungal Infections: Candida, Aspergillus, Cryptococcus, Mucor
description: Candida (germ tubes at 37C), Aspergillus (45-degree acute branching), Cryptococcus (India ink halo, sabouraud agar, latex agglutination), Mucor (90-degree non-septate in DKA).

title: Malaria Parasitology: Plasmodium species & Life Cycle
description: P. falciparum (irregular fever, cerebral malaria, banana-shaped gametocytes), P. vivax/ovale (hypnozoites in liver requiring primaquine), Anopheles mosquito vector.

title: Arboviruses: Dengue, Yellow Fever, Zika, Chikungunya
description: Aedes aegypti mosquito transmission. Dengue breakbone fever & hemorrhagic shock (antibody-dependent enhancement), Zika microcephaly, Chikungunya polyarthralgia.

title: Helminths: Intestinal Nematodes, Cestodes, and Trematodes
description: Enterobius (Scotch tape test), Ascaris (biliary obstruction), Strongyloides (autoinfection hyperinfection in steroid use), Taenia solium (cysticercosis), Schistosoma (portal/bladder).

title: Bacterial Endotoxins (LPS) vs Exotoxins Mechanisms
description: Lipid A trigger of TLR4 on macrophages (IL-1, IL-6, TNF-alpha, nitric oxide, septic shock) vs A-B toxins (Diphtheria/Exotoxin A ADP-ribosylation, Cholera Gs cAMP).

title: Bordetella pertussis & Corynebacterium diphtheriae
description: Pertussis toxin (Gi ADP-ribosylation, lymphocytosis, whooping cough) vs Diphtheria pseudomembrane, EF-2 ADP-ribosylation, Elek test for toxin.

title: Gastrointestinal Protozoa: Giardia vs Entamoeba vs Cryptosporidium
description: Giardia duodenalis (steatorrhea, trophozoites with smiling face / falling leaf motility) vs Entamoeba histolytica (flask-shaped ulcers, liver abscess, RBC ingestion).

title: Rabies Virus: Neurotropism, Negri Bodies, and Post-Exposure Prophylaxis
description: Rhabdovirus bullet-shaped envelope, binding to nicotinic ACh receptors, retrograde axonal transport to CNS, cytoplasmic Negri bodies in Purkinje cells/hippocampus.

title: Borrelia burgdorferi & Lyme Disease Stages
description: Ixodes tick vector. Stage 1 (Erythema migrans target rash), Stage 2 (Bilateral Bell's palsy, AV block), Stage 3 (Migratory large joint polyarthritis, encephalopathy).

title: Bacterial Genetics: Transformation, Conjugation, Transduction, Transposition
description: Competence DNA uptake (S. pneumo transformation), F-plasmid sex pilus high-frequency recombination (conjugation), generalized vs specialized bacteriophage (transduction).

title: Zoonotic Bacterial Infections: Brucella, Francisella, Bartonella, Yersinia
description: Unpasteurized dairy / undulant fever (Brucella), Rabbit skinning / ulceroglandular (Francisella), Cat scratch / bacillary angiomatosis (Bartonella), Fleas / bubonic plague (Yersinia pestis).

title: Influenza Virus: Antigenic Drift vs Antigenic Shift
description: Segmented RNA genome (8 segments). Hemagglutinin (entry) and Neuraminidase (release). Point mutations (drift = seasonal epidemics) vs Gene reassortment (shift = pandemics).

title: Human Papillomavirus (HPV) Oncogenesis: E6 and E7 Oncoproteins
description: High-risk strains HPV 16 and 18. E6 inhibits and degrades p53 tumor suppressor; E7 binds and inactivates Rb pocket protein to release E2F.

title: Bacterial Meningitis Pathogens Across Age Groups
description: Neonates (GBS, E. coli, Listeria monocytogenes), Children/Adults (S. pneumoniae, N. meningitidis), Elderly/Immunocompromised (Listeria coverage with Ampicillin).

title: Chlamydia trachomatis: Serovars and Pathology
description: Elementary body (infectious) vs Reticulate body (replicating). Serovars A-C (Trachoma blindness), D-K (Urethritis/PID/Neonatal conjunctivitis), L1-L3 (Lymphogranuloma venereum).

title: Infectious Mononucleosis: EBV vs CMV Differentiation
description: Atypical reactive CD8+ T-lymphocytes (Downey cells). Heterophile antibody positive (Monospot / EBV) vs Heterophile negative mononucleosis (CMV).

title: Anaerobic Bacteria: Bacteroides fragilis & Actinomyces israelii
description: B. fragilis intra-abdominal abscesses (metronidazole coverage) vs Actinomyces yellow sulfur granules in draining facial sinuses following dental trauma.

title: Superficial Cutaneous Mycoses: Dermatophytes & Tinea Versicolor
description: Microsporum, Trichophyton, Epidermophyton (branching septate hyphae on KOH prep) vs Malassezia globosa / furfur (spaghetti and meatballs appearance in tinea versicolor).

title: Acute Chest Pain: Acute Coronary Syndrome Triage & EKG Leads
description: 58-year-old male with crushing substernal chest pain radiating to left jaw. STEMI criteria, inferior (II, III, aVF) vs anterior (V1-V4) leads, MONA-B protocol, PCI door-to-balloon time.

title: Acute Dyspnea: Suspected Pulmonary Embolism & Wells Criteria
description: 32-year-old female on oral contraceptives post-flight with pleuritic chest pain and hemoptysis. Wells score calculation, D-dimer vs CT Pulmonary Angiography, heparin initiation.

title: Diabetic Ketoacidosis (DKA) Emergency Management
description: 19-year-old Type 1 Diabetic with vomiting, Kussmaul breathing, glucose 450, anion gap 22. IV fluid resuscitation, regular insulin infusion, potassium monitoring protocol.

title: Altered Mental Status: Sepsis & Septic Shock Resuscitation
description: 72-year-old nursing home resident with fever, tachypnea, BP 78/45, lactate 4.2. Sepsis-3 definitions, 1-hour bundle: blood cultures, broad-spectrum antibiotics, 30 mL/kg crystalloids, norepinephrine.

title: Acute Abdominal Pain: Suspected Acute Appendicitis
description: 21-year-old male with periumbilical pain migrating to right lower quadrant, nausea, low-grade fever. McBurney's point tenderness, Rovsing, Psoas, and Obturator signs.

title: Sudden Neurological Deficit: Acute Ischemic Stroke Code
description: 67-year-old female with sudden right-sided hemiplegia and expressive aphasia. Last known well time, Non-contrast Head CT to rule out hemorrhage, IV thrombolysis (tPA/TNK) vs Mechanical Thrombectomy.

title: Severe Headache: Subarachnoid Hemorrhage Workup
description: 'Worst headache of my life' (thunderclap), meningismus, photophobia. Non-contrast CT sensitivity timeline, lumbar puncture looking for xanthochromia, nimodipine for vasospasm.

title: Trauma: Tension Pneumothorax vs Cardiac Tamponade
description: MVA victim with hypotension, tachycardia, and distended neck veins. Tracheal deviation and absent breath sounds (Tension Pneumo / needle decompression) vs Beck's triad and pulsus paradoxus (Tamponade).

title: Acute Upper Gastrointestinal Bleeding: Variceal vs Peptic Ulcer
description: 48-year-old with hematemesis, melena, tachycardia. Glasgow-Blatchford score, IV PPI vs Octreotide, Ceftriaxone in cirrhotic bleed, emergent endoscopy and band ligation.

title: Severe Acute Asthma Exacerbation in Emergency Department
description: 16-year-old with wheezing, tachypnea, accessory muscle use, silent chest warning sign. Inhaled albuterol/ipratropium, systemic corticosteroids, IV magnesium sulfate, criteria for intubation.

title: Anaphylactic Shock: Recognition and Epinephrine Protocol
description: 24-year-old with hives, lip swelling, wheezing, and hypotension within 10 min of peanut ingestion. First-line IM Epinephrine (1:1000) anterolateral thigh dose, airway, IV fluids, adjuncts.

title: Hypertensive Emergency with End-Organ Damage
description: 54-year-old with BP 220/130, papilledema, acute pulmonary edema, or aortic dissection. Target blood pressure reduction limits (max 25% in 1st hour), IV Nicardipine/Labetalol vs Nitroprusside.

title: Severe Hyperkalemia with EKG Changes
description: End-stage renal disease patient with K+ 7.4 mEq/L, peaked T waves, wide QRS. Membrane stabilization (IV Calcium gluconate), intracellular shift (Insulin+D50, Albuterol), elimination (Kayexalate, Hemodialysis).

title: Acute Bacterial Meningitis: Diagnostic Lumbar Puncture & Empiric Therapy
description: 22-year-old college student with fever, severe neck stiffness (Kernig/Brudzinski), purpuric rash. CSF profile (high opening pressure, neutrophils, low glucose, high protein), Vancomycin + Ceftriaxone + Dexamethasone.

title: Syncope Evaluation: Vasovagal vs Orthostatic vs Cardiogenic
description: Sudden loss of consciousness during exertion vs after prolonged standing with prodromal warmth/nausea. EKG screening for long QT, Brugada, WPW, hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HOCM).

title: Acute Pancreatitis: Diagnosis & Ranson/BISAP Criteria
description: Epigastric pain radiating to back, relieved by leaning forward. Lipase > 3x upper limit of normal, ultrasound for gallstones, aggressive fluid resuscitation (Lactated Ringer's), nutritional strategy.

title: First Unprovoked Seizure: Status Epilepticus Algorithm
description: Continuous generalized tonic-clonic activity > 5 min. Step 1 (IV Lorazepam / IM Midazolam), Step 2 (IV Levetiracetam / Fosphenytoin), Step 3 (Propofol / Midazolam infusion & intubation).

title: Acute Monarthritis: Septic Arthritis vs Gout Flare
description: Hot, swollen, acutely painful right knee with inability to bear weight. Urgent arthrocentesis: synovial fluid WBC > 50,000, Gram stain/culture vs intracellular birefringent crystals.

title: Thyroid Storm vs Myxedema Coma Endocrine Crises
description: Thyrotoxic crisis (fever, delirium, tachyarrhythmia: Propranolol, PTU, Lugol iodine, Hydrocortisone) vs Hypothyroid coma (hypothermia, hypoventilation, bradycardia: IV Levothyroxine + Hydrocortisone).

title: Preeclampsia with Severe Features & Eclampsia Protocol
description: 34-week pregnant female with BP 170/110, headache, scotomas, hyperreflexia. IV Magnesium sulfate for seizure prophylaxis (therapeutic levels, calcium gluconate antidote), Hydralazine/Labetalol, delivery planning.

title: Acetaminophen Overdose: Rumack-Matthew Nomogram & NAC Protocol
description: Ingestion of 30 Tylenol tablets 4 hours ago. 4-hour serum APAP level plotted on Rumack-Matthew nomogram, NAPQI glutathione depletion, N-acetylcysteine (NAC) replenishment therapy.

title: Carbon Monoxide Poisoning vs Cyanide Toxicity
description: House fire smoke inhalation victims. Cherry red skin / pulse oximeter artifact / carboxyhemoglobin level (100% O2) vs severe lactic acidosis / bitter almond odor (Hydroxocobalamin / Sodium thiosulfate).

title: Massive Blood Transfusion Protocol & Complications
description: Exsanguinating trauma patient. 1:1:1 ratio (PRBCs, FFP, Platelets). Risks of hypocalcemia (citrate toxicity), hypothermia, hyperkalemia, and TRALI vs TACO.

title: Deep Neck Space Infection: Ludwig's Angina Workup
description: Submandibular and sublingual space cellulitis post lower molar infection, wooden elevation of tongue, stridor. Immediate airway protection (fiberoptic intubation/tracheostomy), IV antibiotics.

title: Acute Limb Ischemia: The 6 P's and Revascularization
description: Pain, Pallor, Pulselessness, Paresthesias, Poikilothermia, Paralysis. Embolic vs in-situ thrombosis, emergent systemic heparinization, surgical embolectomy (Fogarty catheter) vs catheter-directed thrombolysis.

title: Pediatric Stridor: Croup vs Epiglottitis vs Foreign Body
description: Barking seal-like cough & steeple sign (Croup / dexamethasone, racemic epi) vs Toxic high fever, tripod position, thumbprint sign (Epiglottitis / do not agitate, emergent intubation).

title: Spinal Cord Compression: Emergent Oncologic Triage
description: Cancer patient with progressive thoracic back pain worse when supine, lower extremity weakness, urinary retention. Immediate high-dose IV Dexamethasone, emergent total spine MRI, radiation oncology/neurosurgery consult.

title: Heat Stroke vs Heat Exhaustion Management
description: Core body temperature > 40°C with altered mental status / CNS dysfunction vs preserved mentation. Rapid evaporative/conductive ice-water immersion cooling, avoidance of antipyretics.

title: Acute Angle-Closure Glaucoma Presentation & Medical Decompression
description: Severe unilateral eye pain, headache, halos around lights, fixed mid-dilated pupil, rock-hard globe. Medical cocktail: Topical Timolol, Apraclonidine, Pilocarpine, IV Acetazolamide/Mannitol, laser iridotomy.

title: Ectopic Pregnancy with Rupture: Emergency Evaluation
description: Reproductive-age female with amenorrhea, sudden unilateral pelvic pain, vaginal spotting, peritoneal signs, and hypotension. Transvaginal ultrasound (empty uterus, adnexal mass, free fluid), beta-hCG, emergent laparoscopy.

title: Refeeding Syndrome: Pathophysiology & Prevention Protocols
description: Insulin surge post-carbohydrate reintroduction causing rapid cellular shift of phosphate, magnesium, and potassium. Hypophosphatemia cardiac arrest risk, thiamine pre-loading protocol.

title: Enteral vs Total Parenteral Nutrition (TPN)
description: Gut mucosal atrophy prevention in enteral feeding vs central line sepsis, hypertriglyceridemia, and cholestatic liver disease in TPN.

title: Medical Nutrition Therapy in Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD)
description: Protein intake targets in non-dialysis vs hemodialysis, phosphorus binders, potassium restriction, sodium limits, and vitamin D/calcium balance.

title: Ketogenic Diet in Refractory Pediatric Epilepsy
description: 4:1 lipid-to-(protein+carb) ratio, beta-hydroxybutyrate and acetoacetate synthesis, GABA synthesis upregulation, monitoring for nephrolithiasis and dyslipidemia.

title: DASH & Mediterranean Diets: Cardiovascular & Endothelial Impact
description: High potassium/magnesium/calcium, rich monounsaturated fatty acids (extra virgin olive oil), polyphenol antioxidant pathways, blood pressure and lipid lowering.

title: Celiac Disease vs Non-Celiac Gluten Sensitivity
description: Anti-tTG IgA, anti-EMA, duodenal villous blunting (Marsh classification). Strict lifelong gluten-free diet (wheat, rye, barley) and hidden gluten cross-contamination.

title: Low-FODMAP Diet in Irritable Bowel Syndrome (IBS)
description: Fermentable Oligo-, Di-, Mono-saccharides and Polyols. Osmotic luminal water retention, colonic gas production, 3-phase protocol: elimination, re-challenge, personalization.

title: Vitamin D Metabolism, Bioavailability & Bone Health
description: Ergocalciferol (D2) vs Cholecalciferol (D3), hepatic 25-hydroxylation, renal 1-alpha-hydroxylation (PTH-driven). Osteomalacia vs Rickets, target 25(OH)D levels.

title: Vitamin B12 vs Folate Deficiency: Differential & Metabolic Markers
description: Macrocytic megaloblastic anemia. Subacute combined degeneration (SCD) of spinal cord in B12 (dorsal columns/corticospinal). Elevated Methylmalonic acid in B12 only; Homocysteine elevated in both.

title: Wernicke-Korsakoff Syndrome & Thiamine (B1) Kinetics
description: Thiamine pyrophosphate (TPP) cofactor for pyruvate dehydrogenase, alpha-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase, transketolase. Triad (confusion, ataxia, ophthalmoplegia), rule: IV thiamine BEFORE dextrose.

title: Dietary Fiber, Short-Chain Fatty Acids (SCFAs) & Microbiome
description: Soluble (viscous/fermentable) vs Insoluble fiber. Colonic fermentation producing acetate, propionate, and butyrate (colonocyte fuel, Treg anti-inflammatory induction).

title: Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatohepatitis (MASLD / NAFLD)
description: Dietary high-fructose corn syrup, de novo lipogenesis, hepatic insulin resistance. Target 7-10% weight loss, Mediterranean dietary pattern, vitamin E role.

title: Energy Expenditure Calculations & Nitrogen Balance
description: Basal Metabolic Rate (BMR) formulas (Mifflin-St Jeor), Activity and Stress injury factors. Nitrogen balance equation (Protein intake/6.25 - [Urinary urea nitrogen + 4]).

title: Post-Bariatric Surgery Micronutrient Malabsorption
description: Roux-en-Y gastric bypass vs Sleeve gastrectomy. Deficiencies in Iron, Calcium, B12, Thiamine, Copper, Zinc, and Fat-soluble vitamins. Lifelong supplementation protocols.

title: Iron Absorption: Heme vs Non-Heme & Enhancers/Inhibitors
description: Duodenal cytochrome b (DCYTB), DMT-1 transporter, ascorbic acid (vitamin C) enhancement vs phytates, tannins, and calcium inhibition. Ferroportin and hepcidin axis.

title: Phenylketonuria (PKU): Metabolic Defect & Dietary Prescription
description: Phenylalanine hydroxylase (PAH) or BH4 cofactor deficiency. Toxic accumulation of phenylalanine causing severe intellectual disability. Strict Phe-restricted medical formula + Tyrosine supplementation.

title: Glycemic Index vs Glycemic Load in Diabetes Management
description: Rate of blood glucose surge (GI) vs Total available carbohydrate per serving (GL = GI x carb grams / 100). Impact on postprandial glucose excursions and insulin demand.

title: Fat-Soluble Vitamins (A, D, E, K) in Malabsorption Syndromes
description: Pancreatic insufficiency (Cystic Fibrosis, Chronic Pancreatitis) and cholestasis (PBC/PSC). Night blindness (A), Coagulopathy/prolonged PT (K), Hemolytic anemia/ataxia (E), Osteomalacia (D).

title: Zinc Deficiency & Acrodermatitis Enteropathica
description: ZIP4 transporter mutation or nutritional deficit. Periorificial and acral dermatitis, alopecia, diarrhea, impaired wound healing, hypogonadism, dysgeusia (loss of taste).

title: Sarcopenia & Protein Nutrition in Geriatric Medicine
description: Age-related anabolic resistance, loss of muscle mass and physical function. Target protein 1.2-1.5 g/kg/day, leucine threshold for muscle protein synthesis, resistance training synergy.

title: Gout: Dietary Purines, Fructose, and Uric Acid Kinetics
description: High-purine foods (red meat, shellfish), beer (guanosine/alcohol lactic acid competition in kidney), and fructose (rapid ATP depletion to AMP/uric acid).

title: Pediatric Failure to Thrive (FTT): Nutritional Rehabilitation
description: Weight drop across 2 major percentiles or < 5th percentile. Caloric density concentration (24-30 kcal/oz), high-calorie fortification, organic vs non-organic environmental etiology.

title: Maple Syrup Urine Disease & Galactosemia Nutrition
description: Branched-chain alpha-ketoacid dehydrogenase deficiency (Leucine, Isoleucine, Valine restriction) vs Galactose-1-phosphate uridylyltransferase (GALT) deficiency (strict lactose/galactose elimination).

title: Essential Fatty Acids: Omega-3 (EPA/DHA) vs Omega-6 Pathways
description: Alpha-linolenic acid (ALA) to EPA/DHA (anti-inflammatory resolvins, PGE3, LTB5) vs Linoleic acid to Arachidonic acid (pro-inflammatory PGE2, LTB4). Target Omega-6:Omega-3 ratio.

title: Epidemiological Study Designs: Hierarchy & Methodologies
description: Cohort (prospective/retrospective, relative risk), Case-Control (rare diseases, odds ratio), Cross-Sectional (prevalence snapshot), Ecological (population-level fallacy).

title: Measures of Association: Odds Ratio vs Relative Risk vs Hazard Ratio
description: OR (ad/bc in case-control) vs RR (incidence in exposed / unexposed in cohort) vs HR (time-to-event survival rate comparison). Rare disease assumption (OR approximates RR).

title: Diagnostic Test Validity: Sensitivity, Specificity, PPV & NPV
description: Sensitivity (rule OUT, SnNout), Specificity (rule IN, SpPin). Impact of disease prevalence on Positive Predictive Value (increases with prevalence) and Negative Predictive Value.

title: Principles of Population Screening: Wilson-Jungner Criteria
description: Important health problem, recognizable latent/early stage, acceptable safe test, effective treatment available, cost-effective. Lead-time bias vs Length bias.

title: Herd Immunity Threshold & Basic Reproduction Number (R0)
description: Formula: HIT = 1 - (1/R0). Measles (R0 ~ 12-18, HIT ~ 95%), COVID-19 variations. Effective reproductive number (Rt) modulation via non-pharmaceutical interventions and vaccination.

title: Vaccine Platforms: Live-Attenuated, Inactivated, Subunit, mRNA
description: Live (MMR, Varicella, Rotavirus: strong humoral+cell-mediated immunity, contraindicated in pregnancy/severe immunosuppression) vs mRNA (lipid nanoparticles) vs Recombinant protein subunit.

title: Outbreak Investigation: CDC 10-Step Field Epidemiology
description: Verify diagnosis, confirm outbreak existence, establish case definition (confirmed, probable, suspect), construct epidemic curve (point-source vs continuous vs propagated), implement immediate controls.

title: Social Determinants of Health (SDOH) & Health Equity
description: Five domains (Economic stability, Education access, Healthcare quality, Neighborhood environment, Social community). Allostatic load and systemic chronic disease disparities.

title: Cardiovascular Primary Prevention & ASCVD Risk Scoring
description: AHA/ACC 10-year ASCVD pooled cohort equation. Thresholds for moderate vs high-intensity statin initiation, blood pressure targets, lifestyle interventions.

title: Colorectal Cancer Screening Modalities & Guidelines
description: USPSTF start age 45. Colonoscopy every 10 years (visualizing & polypectomy) vs annual Fecal Immunochemical Test (FIT) vs stool DNA-FIT (Cologuard) every 3 years.

title: Cervical Cancer Screening: Pap Cytology & High-Risk HPV Testing
description: Ages 21-29 (Pap cytology every 3 years), Ages 30-65 (hrHPV co-testing every 5 years or Pap every 3 years). Management of ASC-US, LSIL, HSIL per ASCCP guidelines.

title: Tobacco Control, Smoking Cessation Protocols & Pharmacotherapy
description: The 5 A's counseling model (Ask, Advise, Assess, Assist, Arrange). Varenicline (alpha-4-beta-2 partial agonist), Bupropion (NDRI), Nicotine replacement therapy (NRT) combination.

title: Global Burden of Disease: DALYs, YLLs, and YLDs
description: Disability-Adjusted Life Years (DALY = YLL + YLD). Years of Life Lost (mortality) and Years Lived with Disability (morbidity weighted by disability severity). Epidemiological transition.

title: Occupational Pneumoconioses: Asbestosis, Silicosis, Coal Dust
description: Silicosis (sandblasting/quarries, upper lobes, eggshell calcification, TB susceptibility) vs Asbestosis (shipyards/insulation, lower lobes, pleural plaques, mesothelioma/bronchogenic cancer).

title: Antimicrobial Stewardship Programs (ASP) in Healthcare
description: Hospital antibiograms, pre-authorization and prospective audit with feedback, de-escalation of broad-spectrum empiric therapy, preventing C. diff and multi-drug resistant organisms.

title: Maternal Mortality Ratio (MMR) & Obstetric Safety Bundles
description: Maternal deaths per 100,000 live births. Leading causes (postpartum hemorrhage, preeclampsia, sepsis, embolism). AIM hemorrhage safety bundle (quantified blood loss, oxytocin/uterotonics).

title: Healthcare-Associated Infections (HAIs) Prevention Bundles
description: Central Line-Associated Bloodstream Infection (CLABSI chlorhexidine/maximal barrier precautions), Catheter-Associated UTI (CAUTI daily need review), Ventilator-Associated Pneumonia (VAP 30-45 degree head elevation).

title: Bioterrorism Category A High-Priority Pathogens
description: Bacillus anthracis (widened mediastinum, ciprofloxacin), Smallpox (synchronous centrifugal pustules), Yersinia pestis (pneumonic plague), Clostridium botulinum toxin, Francisella tularensis, Ebola virus.

title: One Health Paradigm & Zoonotic Spillover Surveillance
description: Interconnected human, animal, and environmental ecosystem health. Wildlife reservoir surveillance, live-animal market biosecurity, deforestation spillover interface.

title: Water, Sanitation, and Hygiene (WASH) in Global Health
description: Fecal-oral transmission pathways (F-diagram: fluids, fields, flies, fingers, food). Point-of-use chlorination, oral rehydration salts (ORS), and cholera epidemic mitigation.

title: Formulating Clinical Research Questions: The PICO Framework
description: Population/Patient, Intervention, Comparison/Control, Outcome. Turning ambiguous clinical dilemmas into answerable, precise, searchable biomedical questions.

title: The Evidence Hierarchy: From In-Vitro to Systematic Reviews
description: Levels of Evidence (Oxford CEBM): In-vitro/animal -> Expert opinion -> Case series -> Case-control -> Cohort -> RCTs -> Systematic Reviews & Meta-Analyses.

title: Systematic Reviews & Meta-Analyses: PRISMA Guidelines
description: Protocol registration (PROSPERO), comprehensive multi-database search strategy, independent dual screening, data extraction, risk of bias assessment, and PRISMA 2020 flow diagram.

title: Randomized Controlled Trial (RCT) Design & Blinding (CONSORT)
description: Block vs Stratified randomization, Allocation concealment (sequentially numbered opaque envelopes) vs Single/Double/Triple Blinding, Placebo effects, CONSORT statement.

title: Biases in Clinical Research: Selection, Information, Confounding
description: Berkson's bias (hospital controls), Recall bias, Hawthrone effect, Observer bias, Loss-to-follow-up (attrition bias). Strategies to prevent and control bias.

title: Publication Bias & Funnel Plot Interpretation
description: Tendency of journals to publish positive/statistically significant results. Inverted funnel plot of effect size vs standard error; detecting asymmetry with Egger's regression test.

title: Interpreting Forest Plots in Meta-Analyses
description: Individual study squares (size proportional to sample weight), horizontal whiskers (95% CI), vertical line of no effect, summary pooled diamond, I-squared heterogeneity index (>50% substantial).

title: Hypothesis Testing: Type I (Alpha) vs Type II (Beta) Errors
description: Type I error (False Positive: rejecting true null hypothesis, set at alpha=0.05) vs Type II error (False Negative: failing to reject false null, set at beta=0.20). Statistical Power = 1 - Beta (80-90%).

title: P-Values vs 95% Confidence Intervals & Clinical Significance
description: P-value conveys statistical significance against null, whereas 95% CI provides effect size precision, direction, and clinical relevance. Statistically significant does not mean clinically meaningful.

title: Intention-to-Treat (ITT) vs Per-Protocol (PP) Analysis
description: ITT preserves randomization by analyzing subjects in their assigned group regardless of non-compliance/dropout (pragmatic, minimizes bias) vs PP analyzing only protocol-adherent subjects (efficacy ceiling).

title: ROC Curves, Area Under the Curve (AUC) & Likelihood Ratios
description: Receiver Operating Characteristic (Sensitivity vs 1 - Specificity). AUC 0.5 (chance) to 1.0 (perfect). Positive Likelihood Ratio (Sens / [1-Spec]), Negative LR ([1-Sens] / Spec), Fagan's nomogram.

title: Number Needed to Treat (NNT) & Absolute Risk Reduction (ARR)
description: Absolute Risk Reduction (ARR = Control Event Rate - Experimental Event Rate). NNT = 1 / ARR. Number Needed to Harm (NNH = 1 / Absolute Risk Increase). Why Relative Risk can mislead.

title: Confounding Control: Restriction, Matching & Multivariable Regression
description: A confounder is associated with exposure and is an independent risk factor for outcome without being an intermediate. Controlled in design (randomization, matching) or analysis (stratification, multivariable models).

title: Survival Analysis: Kaplan-Meier Curves & Cox Proportional Hazards
description: Time-to-event data with censoring. Step-down Kaplan-Meier survival curves, Log-Rank test for group comparisons, Cox regression Hazard Ratios (HR) assuming constant proportional hazard over time.

title: Critical Appraisal of Clinical Papers: CASP & Cochrane RoB 2
description: Systematic evaluation of study validity, methodology, statistical rigor, magnitude of results, and applicability to your specific patient cohort.

title: The GRADE Framework for Guidelines & Recommendations
description: Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development and Evaluation. Quality of evidence (High, Moderate, Low, Very Low) based on risk of bias, inconsistency, indirectness, imprecision, publication bias.

title: Research Bioethics: Declaration of Helsinki & IRB Governance
description: Belmont Report principles: Respect for Autonomy (informed consent), Beneficence (maximize benefits, minimize harm), and Justice (equitable selection). Institutional Review Board (IRB) review.

title: Literature Searching Mastery: PubMed MeSH & Boolean Operators
description: Medical Subject Headings (MeSH tree hierarchy, explosion, subheadings), Boolean logic (AND narrows, OR broadens, NOT excludes), truncation asterisks, and search filter limits.

title: Peer Review Ethics, Scientific Integrity & Retraction Triggers
description: Single vs double-blind peer review. Scientific misconduct (Fabrication, Falsification, Plagiarism - FFP), predatory journals, Committee on Publication Ethics (COPE) retraction guidelines.

title: Sample Size Calculation & Statistical Power Determinants
description: Four interdependent parameters: Alpha significance level (0.05), Statistical Power (1 - Beta = 0.80), Minimum clinically meaningful Effect Size (Cohen's d / delta), and Population variance/SD.
